about: What each card element may depend on: for every rule, all renders (every registered surface, size, scene and settings, on both platforms) with the same values of 'by' must show the same 'elements' (names and what they show; ' (no room)' = decided but left out for room, counts as shown). The surface is never an input: an element that one surface lays out differently from another with the same inputs fails. 'mode' subset: the shown lists must be one priority order cut at different lengths (slots). 'box': the elements' boxes relative to the chart's bottom-left count too. 'shared': checked across Android and the Mac through expect.json. Facts: ../README.md, 'Layout across surfaces'.

rules.name: value
rules.about: The value's place says the same on every surface that shows it, also a chart card whose chart is gone (3 h+ / no readings: 'face' is true there too). chart.message (the old plain 'No readings since' a graph-only card drew instead) must never come back.

rules.name: value-color
rules.about: The value's colour (its band in the user's ranges, grey when struck) is the same on every card: a card without a chart once used the built-in ranges (the value widget stayed orange after high moved 180 → 200, 2026-10-21).

rules.name: marks
rules.about: What each treatment shows (Settings › Graph › Treatments on the graph: point, mute line, amount label, time label per kind), entry by entry: the same on every surface and both platforms; whether a label fits is the 'labels' rule's.

gaps.about: The % column is its widest drawn label plus this many dp on each side (the user, 2026-10-21: 'it should depend on the longest text width'): column left → widest label's left = gap, every label's right → column right = gap (± 0.05 dp), on every surface, size and platform.

The values on the right of the plot (mg/dL), the same rule mirrored (the user, 2026-10-21: 'can this margin fix logic also be applied to the right axis labels?'): column left (the plot's right edge) → every label's left = gap, widest label's right → column right = gap.

distribution.about: The distribution beside the chart: rows of dots 'pitch' dp apart, dots of radius 'dot', and the outline erased (DST_OUT / .destinationOut) from the lines under them 'cut' dp wider than the dots (the user, 2026-10-21: 'more outline so it masks out more of the content behind'; it was 1.6). CardLayoutTest and -graphselftest check the renderers' constants against these and, on every render with a distribution, the erased outline's box (chart.distribution.cut) against the dots' (chart.distribution.dots): right and top margins = cut (± 0.05 dp).
